short: Bound the weighted gains by a determinant

lean.name: Formalism.B.DetGain
lean.plain: Bound the weighted gains by a determinant
lean.note: For a nonzero integer determinant Δ, if each local gain gₚ is at most the exponent of p in |Δ|, then the sum of gₚ log p over those primes is at most log |Δ|. This proposition records the product-formula estimate outside the final dependency cone.
